content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was an incorrect casting of a user space pointer in the amdgpu driver code, specifically when handling a 64-bit structure member on a 32-bit architecture. This improper cast led to compiler warnings due to size mismatches when the driver attempted to cast user pointers directly to `__user` pointers without an intermediate `unsigned long` conversion, which is necessary to ensure correct handling on both 32-bit and 64-bit systems.
